tagline_i18n.en: AI pair programming in your terminal
tagline_i18n.zh-CN: 终端里的 AI 结对编程

description_i18n.en: Model-agnostic git-aware coding assistant. Edits files via SEARCH/REPLACE blocks, runs tests, dirty-commit workflow. Excellent for non-MCP workflows.
description_i18n.zh-CN: model-agnostic 的 git 友好编码助手，通过 SEARCH/REPLACE 改文件、跑测试、自动提交。非 MCP 流程的标杆。

label_i18n.en: Bring your own provider API keys

description_i18n.en: Aider has no subscription tier — supply keys for whichever providers your selected model uses (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / DeepSeek / OpenRouter / etc.).
description_i18n.zh-CN: Aider 没有订阅版，需要你提供所选模型对应 provider 的 API key（Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / DeepSeek / OpenRouter 等）。

description_i18n.en: Use a local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible local server. Free + offline; quality depends on model.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用本地 Ollama 或任意 OpenAI 兼容的本地服务。免费 + 离线，效果取决于模型。

description_i18n.en: Native CLI for Claude models with edit/read/bash tools, slash commands, MCP support, and project-aware context. The reference Anthropic agent.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 运行在终端里的 Claude 编码 agent，支持文件编辑、shell 执行、斜杠命令、MCP，并能感知项目结构。

label_i18n.zh-CN: Anthropic 官方订阅 (OAuth) — 默认

description_i18n.en: Sign in with your claude.ai account. Uses your Pro / Team subscription quota. No API key is injected; no per-token billing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用你的 claude.ai 账号登录，走你已购的 Pro / Team 订阅额度。不注入任何 API key，不按 token 计费。

label_i18n.en: Bring your own Anthropic API key

description_i18n.en: Bypass the subscription and bill calls to your console.anthropic.com API key. Per-token pricing applies.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跳过订阅，按 token 计费到你 console.anthropic.com 的 API key。

description_i18n.en: OpenRouter, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, a corporate proxy, or any Anthropic-compatible endpoint. You supply the base URL + a key valid for that endpoint.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenRouter / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex / 公司 gateway / 任意 Anthropic 兼容端点。需要你提供 base URL 和对应的 API key。

description_i18n.en: OpenAI's TUI coding agent for GPT-class models. Sandboxed exec, approval gates, MCP support, repository-aware context.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenAI 的 TUI 编码 agent，支持沙盒执行、审批流、MCP，repo-aware。

label_i18n.zh-CN: ChatGPT 官方订阅 (OAuth) — 默认

description_i18n.en: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. Uses your Plus / Pro / Team subscription quota. No API key injected; no per-token billing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用你的 ChatGPT 账号登录，走 Plus / Pro / Team 订阅额度。不注入 API key，不按 token 计费。

label_i18n.en: Bring your own OpenAI API key

description_i18n.en: Bypass the subscription and bill calls to your platform.openai.com API key. Per-token pricing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跳过订阅，按 token 计费到你 platform.openai.com 的 API key。

label_i18n.zh-CN: 自定义端点 / OpenAI 兼容网关

description_i18n.en: Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, a corporate proxy, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supply base URL + endpoint key.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI / OpenRouter / 公司 gateway / 任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。需要 base URL 和对应 key。

tagline_i18n.zh-CN: Google 官方 Gemini agent CLI

description_i18n.en: TUI agent for Gemini models. ReAct loop, function calling, repo-aware tools, MCP roadmap.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 运行在终端的 Gemini agent，支持 ReAct、function calling、repo-aware 工具，MCP 在 roadmap 上。

description_i18n.en: Sign in with your Google account. Uses the free tier / AI Pro / Gemini Advanced quota tied to that account.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Google 账号登录，走该账号的免费层 / AI Pro / Gemini Advanced 额度。

label_i18n.en: Bring your own Gemini API key

description_i18n.en: Use a key from Google AI Studio. Per-token pricing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Google AI Studio 申请的 API key，按 token 计费。

description_i18n.en: Route through Vertex AI in a GCP project. Uses gcloud auth — no API key needed if `gcloud auth application-default login` is set up.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 GCP 项目的 Vertex AI 走，用 gcloud 凭证，配好 `gcloud auth application-default login` 即可无需 API key。

tagline_i18n.en: Open-source provider-agnostic coding agent with native MCP
tagline_i18n.zh-CN: 开源、provider-agnostic、原生 MCP 的编码 agent

description_i18n.en: Pure-TUI coding agent. Native MCP server + client, swap providers (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenRouter / local) per session, share sessions over the web.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 纯 TUI 编码 agent，原生 MCP，跨 provider 自由切换，可分享 session 到 web。

label_i18n.en: Bring your own provider API keys (recommended)
label_i18n.zh-CN: 自带 provider API key (推荐)

description_i18n.en: OpenCode has no subscription tier — you supply keys directly for whichever providers you want to use (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenRouter / etc.). Keys land in the OS keychain; OpenCode reads them from env at launch.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenCode 没有订阅版，需要你自己提供 provider 的 API key（Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenRouter 等）。Key 存进系统 keychain，OpenCode 启动时从环境变量读取。

label_i18n.zh-CN: 本地模型服务 (Ollama / LM Studio)

description_i18n.en: Point OpenCode at a locally-running OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Free, fully local, no key.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenCode 指向本地跑的 OpenAI 兼容端点。免费，完全本地，无需 API key。
